PSA 44:1.KJV: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil. We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
PSA 44:1.BHSA: אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ בְּאָזְנֵ֬ינוּ שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֲבֹותֵ֥ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָ֑נוּ פֹּ֥עַל פָּעַ֥לְתָּ בִֽ֝ימֵיהֶ֗ם בִּ֣ימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃

PSA 44:2.KJV: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
PSA 44:2.BHSA: אַתָּ֤ה׀ יָדְךָ֡ גֹּויִ֣ם הֹ֭ורַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵ֑ם תָּרַ֥ע לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃

PSA 44:3.KJV: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
PSA 44:3.BHSA: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א בְחַרְבָּ֡ם יָ֥רְשׁוּ אָ֗רֶץ וּזְרֹועָם֮ לֹא־הֹושִׁ֢יעָ֫ה לָּ֥מֹו כִּֽי־יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וּ֭זְרֹועֲךָ וְאֹ֥ור פָּנֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣י רְצִיתָֽם׃

PSA 44:4.KJV: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
PSA 44:4.BHSA: אַתָּה־ה֣וּא מַלְכִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים צַ֝וֵּ֗ה יְשׁוּעֹ֥ות יַעֲקֹֽב׃

PSA 44:5.KJV: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
PSA 44:5.BHSA: בְּ֭ךָ צָרֵ֣ינוּ נְנַגֵּ֑חַ בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ נָב֥וּס קָמֵֽינוּ׃

PSA 44:6.KJV: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
PSA 44:6.BHSA: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְקַשְׁתִּ֣י אֶבְטָ֑ח וְ֝חַרְבִּ֗י לֹ֣א תֹושִׁיעֵֽנִי׃

PSA 44:7.KJV: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

PSA 44:8.KJV: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
PSA 44:8.BHSA: בֵּֽ֭אלֹהִים הִלַּלְ֣נוּ כָל־הַיֹּ֑ום וְשִׁמְךָ֓׀ לְעֹולָ֖ם נֹודֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃

PSA 44:9.KJV: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

PSA 44:10.KJV: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
PSA 44:10.BHSA: תְּשִׁיבֵ֣נוּ אָ֭חֹור מִנִּי־צָ֑ר וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֵ֗ינוּ שָׁ֣סוּ לָֽמֹו׃

PSA 44:11.KJV: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

PSA 44:12.KJV: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.

PSA 44:13.KJV: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
PSA 44:13.BHSA: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבֹותֵֽינוּ׃

PSA 44:14.KJV: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

PSA 44:15.KJV: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
PSA 44:15.BHSA: כָּל־הַ֭יֹּום כְּלִמָּתִ֣י נֶגְדִּ֑י וּבֹ֖שֶׁת פָּנַ֣י כִּסָּֽתְנִי׃

PSA 44:16.KJV: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
PSA 44:16.BHSA: מִ֭קֹּול מְחָרֵ֣ף וּמְגַדֵּ֑ף מִפְּנֵ֥י אֹ֝ויֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃

PSA 44:17.KJV: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
PSA 44:17.BHSA: כָּל־זֹ֣את בָּ֭אַתְנוּ וְלֹ֣א שְׁכַחֲנ֑וּךָ וְלֹֽא־שִׁ֝קַּ֗רְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶֽךָ׃

PSA 44:18.KJV: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
PSA 44:18.BHSA: לֹא־נָסֹ֣וג אָחֹ֣ור לִבֵּ֑נוּ וַתֵּ֥ט אֲשֻׁרֵ֗ינוּ מִנִּ֥י אָרְחֶֽךָ׃

PSA 44:19.KJV: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
PSA 44:19.BHSA: כִּ֣י דִ֭כִּיתָנוּ בִּמְקֹ֣ום תַּנִּ֑ים וַתְּכַ֖ס עָלֵ֣ינוּ בְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃

PSA 44:20.KJV: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
PSA 44:20.BHSA: אִם־שָׁ֭כַחְנוּ שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַנִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּ֝פֵּ֗ינוּ לְאֵ֣ל זָֽר׃

PSA 44:21.KJV: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
PSA 44:21.BHSA: הֲלֹ֣א אֱ֭לֹהִים יַֽחֲקָר־זֹ֑את כִּֽי־ה֥וּא יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ תַּעֲלֻמֹ֥ות לֵֽב׃

PSA 44:22.KJV: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
PSA 44:22.BHSA: כִּֽי־עָ֭לֶיךָ הֹרַ֣גְנוּ כָל־הַיֹּ֑ום נֶ֝חְשַׁ֗בְנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן טִבְחָֽה׃

PSA 44:23.KJV: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
PSA 44:23.BHSA: ע֤וּרָה׀ לָ֖מָּה תִישַׁ֥ן׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י הָ֝קִ֗יצָה אַל־תִּזְנַ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח׃

PSA 44:24.KJV: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

PSA 44:25.KJV: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
PSA 44:25.BHSA: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ דָּבְקָ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ בִּטְנֵֽנוּ׃

PSA 44:26.KJV: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
PSA 44:26.BHSA: ק֭וּמָֽה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לָּ֑נוּ וּ֝פְדֵ֗נוּ לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
